title: EVs Can Use Their Brakes Less and Still Need Brake Attention
topic: Regenerative braking can reduce friction-brake use and allow rotor corrosion
mechanicTruth: Electric and hybrid vehicles can use regenerative braking for part of deceleration, reducing friction-brake use; reduced use can give rotor surface corrosion more opportunity to develop.
